mapper.select: SELECT document_id, document_name, keywords FROM documents

SELECT d.document_name AS documentName, CASE WHEN ud.user_document_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS completed FROM required_documents rd JOIN documents d ON rd.document_id = d.document_id LEFT JOIN user_documents ud ON d.document_id = ud.document_id AND ud.user_id = #{userId} WHERE rd.policy_id = #{policyId}
